name: Swamp Fellas
detailed_description:
Welcome to Swamp Fellas, a laid-back multiplayer swamp sim up to 8 players where you fish, fart, and frog around with your friends. Chill by the fire. Catch legendary creatures, or a sea mine. Hit someone with a stick. Find secrets.

🐸 Key Features:

  • Catch Strange Creatures in different biomes:
    Fill your journal with everything from snails to swamp cryptids. The rarer the catch, the weirder the bragging rights.

  • Fully Voiced Third Space:
    Proximity voice chat makes every burp, croak, and ukulele solo part of the experience.

  • Customizable Frogs:
    Hats. Glasses. Big ol’ boots. Show off your pondsona.

  • Interactive Toys & Tools:
    Play instruments badly. Set traps. Throw stuff. Sit on a lily pad. It’s the little things.

  • Explorable Swamp Biome:
    Find secret spots, hidden NPCs, or just get lost in the fog. 

  • Ragdoll Chaos:
    Trip over a turtle. Get launched by a fish. Physics just happens here.

Whether you're fishing for clout or just want to hear your buddy do frog impressions in a hammock, Swamp Fellas is your new favorite hangout.

short_description: Swamp Fellas is a cozy multiplayer game up to 8 players where frogs fish, vibe, and cause mild chaos. Explore a chill island, talk with friends via proximity chat with a reactive character, and mess around with weird props in a third space made for silly fun moments.
